title: A tech story of "Tech story missing." is left out of the report text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is off (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, titled "Replace tie rod" with the description "excessive play".
  • Have line 1 opened in Edit Line and saved once with Save & Close, without typing a tech story, so it holds "Tech story missing.".
  • Have line 1 completed without typing a tech story, and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
  5. In an empty cell, enter =LEN() with line 1's ItemDescription cell inside the brackets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads exactly "Replace tie rod - excessive play".
  • The words "Tech story missing." do not appear, and there is no hyphen or space after "excessive play".

Step 5:

  • The cell shows 32 (15 + 3 + 14 = 32), so nothing is added and nothing trails after the last word.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R6: “A line with no narrative ends after the description, with no trailing hyphen and no trailing space. A narrative is absent when the value is empty, is made only of spaces, or is the literal placeholder "Tech story missing."; the three are treated identically, and none reaches QuickBooks. The Edit Line window writes the placeholder when an existing line with no tech story is saved from it; a line saved from New Line keeps an empty tech story. Neither depends on completion or on Require Tech Story.”
  • Key Decisions: “The "Tech story missing." placeholder is never sent. The line dialog writes that literal sentence when nothing was typed. Both invoice views already refuse to show it to a customer, and the accounting records should not be the one place it appears. A line whose narrative is that placeholder is treated as having none.”

From: Product's answers to our 8 questions (Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, Google Doc 1QcT7FRZci6AhYcI33HUac-Oob03-gCnCOKn2NFHMLjA, saved in po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, answer 6: “It's written when an existing line with no tech story is saved from the Edit Line window: open it, save, and the line holds "Tech story missing." A line saved from New Line keeps an empty tech story. Neither depends on completion or on Require Tech Story (S3-R6).”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
